text:
nora: Heads-up 1 opened a PR to add Central America (ca-1) to our region matrix and a short residency FAQ. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/711
felix: Nice. Support asked for an explicit short line on embeddings: do Dedicated customers get in-country embeddings by default?
irene: Draft text in PR: 
```
Central America (ca-1): Supported. Dedicated and Private deployments: in-region embeddings storage available upon request (subject to contract). Hosted plans: embeddings may be stored outside the country depending on plan tier; contact support for options.
```
felix: Good. Legal prefers "available upon request" and wants to avoid "logs" wording  agree with this wording?
legal-bot: Reviewed. Recommend adding "data processing options available upon request for Dedicated and Private deployments" and append "(subject to contract)" for Hosted residency sentences. Also avoid operational details in public docs.
nora: Updated wording and pushed. Can someone update SDK snippets? Current examples use us-east-1. We should show curl + ruby client init for CA example.
felix: Proposed snippets: 
```
# curl
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: ca-1" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hola"}'

# ruby (redwood gem)
require "redwood"
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV["TOKEN"], region: "ca-1")
client.generate("hola")
```
irene: Nice. Also add a one-line migration note: "Clients using legacy header `region-code` should move to `X-Redwood-Region` (deprecated 2025-01-15). See /docs/migrate-headers."
localization: i18n: we'll need Spanish and Portuguese translations. Mark PR with i18n-needed label.
docs-bot: Link-check failed for /docs/migrate-headers (404)  please point to /docs/migrate-region-headers or create redirect.
nora: I thought we consolidated that page. I'll change the link to /docs/migrate-region-headers and add an internal TODO to reconcile redirect.
felix: Support also asked for a short troubleshooting blurb: "If embedding requests in ca-1 return 422, region quota may not be provisioned; open a support ticket." Add that under FAQ.
irene: Added troubleshooting and the legal phrasing. I removed mention of any KMS specifics from public page and put them on Private deployment page.
legal-bot: Approved the public wording.
docs-bot: CI checks queued for PR #711; link-check will re-run after link changes.
nora: Thanks all  planning to merge after CI green and i18n label applied. Tagging @localization for follow-up. :sparkles:
